open_points.subject: pre-export correction of legacy room names
open_points.text: That correction is made in the legacy v1 instance, by its own means, before the export
open_points.question: What exact legacy action or procedure changes a room name, including for an archived project, and what observable result proves that every selected room now satisfies the naming rule before export?
options: Use a supported legacy UI or API and verify the resulting room list
Use a one-time direct store correction and verify the exported data
Provide a dedicated pre-export correction tool
open_points.default_guess: Use the legacy instance's supported write path, then re-read every selected project's rooms and require an explicit successful check before export.

open_points.subject: failure of the pre-export room-name correction
open_points.text: So the owner, before making the export on the VPS (R0-72), corrects there every room name of the projects to be picked that breaks this rule
open_points.question: What happens when a violating room name cannot be corrected or the owner cannot verify the correction: is the whole export stopped, is that project excluded, or may the import proceed despite the violation?
options: Stop the whole export and import until every selected project passes
Exclude the affected project and export the remaining selected projects
Proceed because Registry neither validates nor refuses room names
open_points.default_guess: Stop the export and import until every room of every selected project has been verified compliant.

witness.initial: A project selected for the one-time migration has a legacy room named after a person's disability, and the legacy correction attempt fails.
events: The owner selects the project for migration and tries to correct the room name in the legacy v1 instance.
The legacy instance does not persist the correction or offers no way to verify it.
The owner reaches the pre-export decision point.
outcomes: The migration is stopped until the room name can be corrected and verified.
The project is omitted, or the export proceeds and Registry imports the unchanged name because the import refuses no room name.
witness.observer: The owner sees a different migration result, and the agent may later see the violating room name in the imported project.
